items.title: 67256_Paul L. Howard oral history interview
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Not the (inaudible)? Avery Parnish Thing, was it? [INTERVIEWEE] No.

ctx.x: Yeah, played everything, and played like the devil. I'm trying to think what -- I'd make him play -- get him to play -- what do you call that? Not the Birth of the Blues, but -- oh, he used to play some blues. What's the name of that tune that everybody played and tried to learn to play here?
Not the (inaudible)? Avery Parnish Thing, was it?
